mainText: Hello, Verona! At 2 PM, here is today's balanced dish: expect clear skies with temperatures reaching 80 degrees near the Verona Public Library.
The Public Works Department is hard at work maintaining our city streets and utilities, and you can stay updated on their projects by subscribing to the City of Verona digital newsletter.
We have plenty to do, including Yoga at Insight Wellness today, followed by Trivia Night at Hop Haus tomorrow and the Verona Downtown Farmer's Market this Wednesday.
In a notable call from the past week, on July 31, an officer conducted a traffic stop that resulted in an O W I arrest and citations for suspended registration.
Indulge in today's flavor, Chocolate Covered Strawberry, available at Culver's until they close at 10 PM.
